cases.why: only the schedule's location decides, so a game listed 'Home' at a stadium that is not the home team's (2026 week 5's PHI at JAX, at Tottenham) says nothing on its card.
the usual stadium is taken as the one a team hosts FEWEST games at, so its London game reads as home and every real home game as neutral.
the weekly run reads the week's rows without the season's usual stadiums, so the stadium rule never fires on a saved pick.
the weekend refresh reads the week's rows without the season's usual stadiums, so a week locked before picks carried the flag never gets it for a game listed 'Home'.
the status snapshot drops the flag, so a neutral game in a week locked before picks carried it never says so.
the page reads the flag from the pick only, so every week locked before picks carried it shows no neutral site.
the line is drawn whatever the flag says, so every home game claims a neutral site.
the venue name from the schedule goes into the card unescaped, so a stray angle bracket in an upstream field becomes markup.
